headline: Saudi Arabia postpones 'Davos in the Desert' (FII10) to 2027 after Ansar Allah missile/drone attacks on Riyadh
dek: Saudi Arabia cancelled the in-person Future Investment Initiative (FII10), scheduled Oct 26-29 in Riyadh, postponing the 10th edition to 2027, after a wave of Ansar Allah missile/drone attacks on the kingdom (incl. deadly Riyadh airport strike killing 13 earlier this month).
sources: Wall Street Journal (scoop), confirmed by FII Institute CEO HRH Princess Dr. Maha Bint Mishari Al Saud statement; reported by Reuters (via Jerusalem Post), CNN, The National, NY Post
fault_line: Did missiles just beat money? Security reality vs Vision 2030 credibility — audiences split on whether MBS is humiliated or being prudent.

sections.what_happened: Saudi Arabia cancelled the in-person Future Investment Initiative (FII10), scheduled Oct 26-29 in Riyadh, postponing the 10th edition to 2027, after a wave of Ansar Allah missile/drone attacks on the kingdom (incl. deadly Riyadh airport strike killing 13 earlier this month). Wall Street executives (Dimon, Fraser teams) were cancelling meetings; organizers scrapped in-person plans Monday then emailed attendees about 2027.
sections.what_verified: WSJ original scoop (2h); Reuters via JPost 20:20; CNN (<1h, email statement seen); The National (official CEO statement); FII Institute IG post (@fii_institute, Oct 19). All agree on: in-person cancelled, 10th edition moved to 2027, new dates TBD, registrations valid.
sections.what_disputed: Official FII statement frames it as quality/impact commitment for the 'landmark tenth edition' — does not name the attacks. Causal link to Ansar Allah attacks is the wire consensus (WSJ/Reuters/CNN/National), not the organizer's stated reason.
sections.why_matters: When missiles hit the airport, the money stays home — the economic front of the Ansar Allah war, mapped: Riyadh airport strike -> CEO cancellations -> MBS's flagship showcase shelved. Pocketbook angle: war is now taxing Saudi's transformation story.
sections.context: Background: Saudi Arabia postpones 'Davos in the Desert' (FII10) to 2027 after Ansar Allah missile/drone attacks on Riyadh — economic front of the Ansar Allah war

totw_analysis: Our read: When missiles hit the airport, the money stays home — the economic front of the Ansar Allah war, mapped: Riyadh airport strike -> CEO cancellations -> MBS's flagship showcase shelved. Pocketbook angle: war is now taxing Saudi's transformation story. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Did missiles just beat money? Security reality vs Vision 2030 credibility — audiences split on whether MBS is humiliated or being prudent.
